title: AudioStreamPlaylist: Dynamic Looping and Playback Controls

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## Summary

This PR enhances the `AudioStreamPlaylist` and corresponding `AudioStreamPlaybackPlaylist` for dynamic control of looping during playback.

It builds on the work by @GustJc started in #95900 and closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/10508

## Details

The core functionality added is the `AudioStreamPlaylist.set_loop_stream(bool)` to toggle whether the current stream should loop or not. This can be done in realtime during playback, allowing the dynamic looping of streams indefinitely and seamlessly transitioning to other streams in the playlist when desired.

The Playback node also gains some enhanced features to dynamically manage playback:
* `AudioStreamPlaybackPlaylist.change_stream(stream_index)` to jump to a specific stream
* `AudioStreamPlaybackPlaylist.next_stream()` to advance to the next stream
* `AudioStreamPlaybackPlaylist.previous_stream()` to back up to the previous stream

And some methods for knowing more about what's playing:
* `AudioStreamPlaybackPlaylist.get_current_stream_index()` to know what playlist stream is currently playing
* `AudioStreamPlaybackPlaylist.get_stream_playback_position()` to get the timecode of the current stream

There are also two signals added to trigger behavior based on stream loops and changes:
* `AudioStreamPlaybackPlaylist.stream_changed` emitted when playback moves to a different stream
* `AudioStreamPlaybackPlaylist.stream looped` emitted when a looping stream completes and starts a new loop

## Sample Code

Here is a sample of using these new features!

```gdscript
func _process(delta):
  process_time += delta
  if process_time >= 0.4:
    process_time = 0.0
    if not self.playback:
      self.playback = $AudioStreamPlayer.get_stream_playback()
      if not self.playback:
        return
    print("Playing clip %s at position %0.2f (total play time %0.2f)" % [
      self.playback.get_current_stream_index(), 
      self.playback.get_stream_playback_position(), 
      self.playback.get_playback_position()
    ])

func set_content():
  var stream_idx = self.playback.get_current_stream_index()
  var stream = self.playlist.get_list_stream(stream_idx)
  print("Set content: %s" % stream)
  if not stream:
    $Content/current_title.text = "No stream at index %d" % stream_idx
    return
  var stream_name = stream.resource_name if stream.resource_name else stream.resource_path
  $Content/current_title.text = stream_name

func on_stream_looped():
  print("Stream looped!")

func on_stream_changed():
  var stream_idx = self.playback.get_current_stream_index()
  var stream = self.playlist.get_list_stream(stream_idx)
  print("Stream changed: [%d] Now playing index %s" % [stream_idx, stream])
  self.set_content()

func on_toggled(is_toggled: bool) -> void:
  print("Setting stream loop to %s" % is_toggled)
  self.playlist.set_loop_stream(is_toggled)
```
